subject: Using MSStats in skyline for group comparison of only 18 samples

messages.subject: Using MSStats in skyline for group comparison of only 18 samples
parts:
Hello, 

I have some clinical samples. Three samples with MS disease and three control samples. I have 6 replicates of each samples which gives me 18 samples in total. I was wondering if I could use MSStats in skyline to do group comparison. Do I have to have technical replicates. By the way, those replicates are just 6 extractions of the same biological replicates.

So many thanks,

Reza Nemati, 

Graduate Assistant

messages.subject: Re: Using MSStats in skyline for group comparison of only 18 samples
parts:
Dear Reza,

form your description it appears that yes, you can use MSstats. The three disease and three control samples are the biological replicates. The extractions of a same biological samples are technical replicates.

Best wishes
Olga
